what: NEAR AI Cloud's conversion from stake.dao farm reward units to US dollars of credits
source: GET https://cloud.near.ai/api/staking/farm/config, read in a signed-in NEAR AI Cloud session (the dashboard's Credits page calls it). The backing API, https://cloud-api.near.ai/v1/staking/farm/config, answers 401 without authorization.
fetched_note: server Date header of the response
how_to_check: Sign in at cloud.near.ai (any method), open the organization's Credits page, and read the response of /api/staking/farm/config in the browser's network tab. The page also states the same rate in words: "$2.00 monthly credits / 100 NEAR".
limits: Off-chain and behind a sign-in: it cannot be read from the chain, a judge needs an account, and it can change with no on-chain trace. It is a snapshot at the time above.
